This suggests that `codestral-latest` may be an alias or a version that includes `codestral-2501`. I need to check if there is a model alias mapping or if `codestral-latest` is a separate model. Let me search for model aliases.
The search returned files for codestral-25-01.ts and codestral-25-08.ts. Let me check the models directory to see if there is a codestral-latest.ts file.

text: Let me check the schema.ts file to see if it defines aliases.

The schema.ts file shows that models can have slugAliases and that models ending with '-latest' are considered aliases. Let me check the codestral-25-08.ts file to see if it has an alias for codestral-latest.

The codestral-25-08.ts file shows that its identifiers.apiNames includes 'codestral-latest' and its capabilities include 'predicted-outputs'. So `codestral-latest` is an alias for `codestral-25-08`. Now I need to check if codestral-25-01 also supports predicted outputs.

Now I see that codestral-25-01 also has predicted-outputs in its capabilities. So both codestral-25-01 and codestral-25-08 (alias codestral-latest) support predicted outputs. The documentation page mentions codestral-latest and mistral-large-2411. I need to check if mistral-large-2411 also has predicted-outputs capability.
The file name is mistral-large-2-1-24-11.ts, which corresponds to mistral-large-2411. Let me check its capabilities.

Now I have confirmation that mistral-large-2411 supports predicted outputs. The documentation page also mentions codestral-latest, which is an alias for codestral-25-08, which also supports predicted outputs. The public/llms-full.txt mentions codestral-2501, which is codestral-25-01, also supports predicted outputs. So the models are codestral-latest (codestral-25-08), codestral-2501 (codestral-25-01), and mistral-large-2411. However, the official documentation page only lists codestral-latest and mistral-large-2411. To be consistent with the official documentation, I should answer with those two models.

content.text:
The Mistral models that support Predicted Outputs are:

- **`codestral-latest`**
- **`mistral-large-2411`**

[Which model supports predicted outputs?](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/advanced/predicted-outputs#which-model-supports-predicted-outputs)
